verdict.rationale: uv is itself an official CLI with a published command reference (uv-probe-4). First-party docs cover `uv init`, `uv add`, `uv run`, `uvx`/`uv tool`, `uv python pin`, `uv cache clean`, `uv self update` and shell autocompletion, plus an official GitHub Action for CI. Community users independently praise its ergonomic CLI, and `uv version --output-format json` shows some machine-readable output useful to agents. Missing for 10: evidence of structured JSON output and non-interactive, agent-oriented behavior across commands beyond `uv version`.
